e1_prerequisites: Implement builder and an independent verifier per construction-spec.md section 7 without shared selection code.
Execute all adversarial cases and properties of the research specification sections 13-14 in Actions.
Two independent Actions recomputations produce the same canonical candidate lock and coverage evidence.
governance: Takes effect when a maintainer merges this record into main. Changes only through a new versioned construction spec and a new freeze record; earlier bytes and records are kept.
limitations: Exploratory pilot: six lineages, one held-out lineage per calibration/evaluation split; no confirmatory sufficiency.
Ancestry negatives cover exact consecutive text in retained members; modified or reformatted copies can be missed, so components are an upper bound. A confirmatory cohort needs a second clone signal.

Historical-byte evidence proves pairwise base-before-target ordering, not release-time existence of every target snapshot; it relies on Wayback and platform record integrity and SHA-1/MD5 second-preimage resistance.
Run 37196309671 lacks the positive control and is superseded; 37196505949 and 37197318303 produce identical evidence, the latter also records archive MD5. All runs are kept.

rulings.A01: Global cross-split quarantine on raw U; retrospective temporal sample, not online causal simulation; only the restricted alias invariances hold.
rulings.A02: Round-robin over groups holding all potential targets; identity consumes a group turn, not near quota; stop at 64 near targets or exhaustion; visited identities and near targets enter the lock.
rulings.A03: duplicate_of is the minimum eligible duplicate occurrence ID.
rulings.A04: Category from all eligible aliases with precedence same-path, same-family, foreign; independent of the representative.
rulings.A05: Every rank is a total order with the identity as secondary key.
rulings.A06: Closed delsk.candidate.lock.v2 binding corpus, policy, construction spec, protocol, ancestry audit, acquisition freeze and historical-bytes evidence.
rulings.A07: Eligibility clock stays the B release interval. Dated public records establish pairwise no-future-base ordering: exact base archive bytes attested before lo(target) for 62/62 usable source pairs. Target bytes are not proven inside their own release interval (11/18 attested later); such snapshots are retrospective, version-indexed. Chunk and tar tracks are modeled.
rulings.A08: Bounded acquired-snapshot audit of all 15 family pairs with stable lead IDs and a reviewed disposition per lead: no shared origin established between roster families, no merge, no new exclusion. Six singleton components are the exploratory upper-bound assignment; split counts 4/1/1 unchanged.
rulings.A09: Seal only from the complete hash-bound U with independent source-to-U and U-to-queries checks.
rulings.A10: Construction accepts closed frozen metadata only; score, encoder, codec, result fields and callbacks are errors.

scope: Slice E0 candidate construction design for the R0 exploratory pilot: adopted semantics A01-A10, closed candidate-lock v2 schema, total orders, golden vectors, retained-origin ancestry audit and historical-byte scope. No candidate lock is sealed; no scorer, encoder, oracle or utility result exists.
